views.recipe: service-meshes: transit chain plus the core fan (core->web, core->cache) in one view, fan ports ordered web-then-cache as the source lists them

attempts.note: 5 nodes, 4 edges, lr, label_slot on fw->core, core->web, core->cache. extent 65x9, crossings 0/0, labels 4/4, ambiguous 0, origins 4/4. Rejected on a visual reading the checker cannot make: the '25 GbE' gutter label sat on the row exactly between the two fan routes (core->Redis one row above, core->Web one row below), so a reader could pair it with either fan edge.

Shipped. Same structure with label_slot removed: the engine places '25 GbE' one row above the up-fan route and '10 GbE' on the down-fan approach row, so each label is unambiguously nearer its own edge. extent 75x9 (fits 77x47), crossings 0/0, labels 4/4, ambiguous 0, origins 4/4, 0 dot violations. Copied byte-identically to specs/v1.json (same sha256).

views.recipe: service-meshes application relations: web/cache/db triangle plus the repeat of core->cache, so the separate core-to-cache and web-to-cache relations are countable in one capture

attempts.note: Shipped and only attempt. 4 nodes, 4 edges, tb, label_slot only on core->cache. extent 37x29, crossings 0/0, labels 4/4, ambiguous 0, origins 4/4, 0 dot violations. Every label sits on its own route's column (session off web->cache by 1 cell, queries off web->db by 1 cell, fill off cache->db by 1 cell, 25 GbE off core->cache by 2 cells). Copied byte-identically to specs/v2.json.

abandoned_shapes.shape: single view, all 6 nodes and 7 edges, tb (no layers pin)
abandoned_shapes.result: extent 30x57 — 10 rows taller than the 47-row target. Labels clean (0 ambiguous) but the height overflows. Not shipped.

abandoned_shapes.shape: single view, all 6 nodes and 7 edges, lr with layers pinning web+cache to one rank
abandoned_shapes.result: rejected by the renderer: 'no obstacle-safe route for web -> cache; increase node/layer spacing'. Pinning web and cache to the same rank puts the web->cache edge inside one rank, which the router cannot draw. Not shipped.

probe_budget_note: Three single-view shapes (v1-a, v1-b, v1-c) measured before any split; when the one-view shape failed on extent and on the same-rank router rejection, the case was split into v1 (transit + core fan) and v2 (application relations), each with its own candidate budget (v1: 2 of 3 used, v2: 1 of 3 used).
